Exam Interface and Features

Exam Navigation

 
Question Status Panel

At the left of the screen, the Question Status Panel indicates your location within the exam section and displays information about the status of each question.

A dot indicates an unanswered question.

A flag indicates a question you have marked.

A pencil indicates a question where you have left a note.
Previous/Next

Moves backward or forward one screen.

The number on the left indicates the current question and the number on right indicates the total number of questions in the current block.
Lock

Locks your exam if you must take an unauthorized break during an exam section. This does not pause the exam timer.
Pause

Pauses the exam session so you can take a break when needed.

Proceeding will close the exam interface and stop the exam timer.
End Block

After completing all the questions in a block, you may click End Block to finalize your responses and proceed to the next block.

Note: You will not be able to return to a block after it has been ended.

Managing Time

Time Explanation
Block Time Remaining Maximum time remaining to complete the current block in which you are working.
Day Time Remaining Maximum time remaining to complete the entire exam.
Item Info Panel

Shows current item (question) number and block.

Clicking on this panel displays an exam overview of the number of items and time allotted for all blocks.
Exam Overview Displays the time allocated to complete each block in the exam including optional blocks (e.g., tutorial, break time), and whether or not the blocks have been completed. This allows you to see exactly how far you have progressed throughout your exam, and how many blocks or how much time is remaining in the exam.
Timer Info Panel

Shows remaining Block Time and Day Time.

Clicking on this panel displays details of block and day timers.

Answering Questions

As you navigate through the questions in your exam, you can select your choice of answer using the mouse or keyboard. You may change your answer at any time until you end the block. Once you have selected an answer you will not be able to return the item to its original unanswered state.

The following tools are available for you to interact with on each question.

Highlight

Left click-and-drag on text in the question to highlight text.

Single click on highlighted text to remove.
Strikeout

Right click on an answer option to strike out that option.

Right click on a strikeout to remove.
Strikeout Button

An optional Strikeout button can be enabled by selecting Show Strikeout in the Settings.

This Strikeout button can be activated via mouse, or by pressing [enter] or [space] on the keyboard.
Mark

Places a flag mark in the Question Status Panel for this question.
Lab Values

Opens a searchable reference containing laboratory values.

SI reference intervals can be optionally displayed.
Notes

Adds a note to the exam question.

A pencil icon will be added to the Question Status Panel for this question.
Calculator

Opens a basic calculator.
Image Invert

Inverts the colors of images.
Image Contrast

Adjusts the contrast of images
Image Magnification

Allows full-screen magnification of images.

Keyboard Controls

Keystroke Function
Tab
Shift + Tab

Go to next (Tab) or previous (Shift + Tab) focusable item (link, button, input, etc.).
Enter or Spacebar

Activate or open a button, link, or interactive element.
Arrow Keys

Navigate within the list of answer options.
Windows: Control +/-
MacOS: Command +/-

Enlarge or reduce.
Spacebar

Select or unselect a checkbox or radio button.
Escape (Esc)

Close a newly opened overlay, such as a modal dialog window, popup, or dropdown menu.
Individual Letter Keys (A,B,C, etc.)

You can also select an answer option by pressing the corresponding letter on the keyboard. For example, A for answer option “A.”

Question Status

On the left of the screen, a Question Status Panel shows your location within the exam block and displays information about the status of each question.

Icon Description
A dot appears to the left of unanswered questions.
The current question is highlighted.
A flag appears to the right of questions that have been marked for review.
A pencil appears to the right of questions where a note has been saved.

Exiting a Block

If there is time remaining, and you wish to end a block, click the End Block button. A window will appear asking you to confirm that you would like to end the block. Once you end a block, you will not be able to revisit the questions or change the answers that you have entered.

The End Block button as it appears when you have unanswered questions remaining in a block.
The End Block button changes to an arrow when you have provided an answer for each question in a block.

When Time Runs Out

If a question is on your screen when the allocated time runs out, and you have answered that question, your answer will be recorded. However, you will not be allowed to answer additional questions in that block. You will be automatically navigated to the next block, where the timer for that block will begin to count down.

Ending the Exam

The exam session ends when End Block is selected for the last block or when time expires for the last block.

Show/Hide Strikeout

When enabled, displays a strikeout icon next to each answer option.

Prohibited Items and Behavior

If you have any unauthorized items in your possession, leave the testing room immediately and place the items in your locker.

Warning: Your possession of any such items after you click "Continue" will be considered intentional.
